items.name: graphuofm/hawkeye
items.description: Hawkeye: a cohesion-aware structural channel for temporal link prediction. A drop-in replacement for the structure channel of SOTA temporal-graph models (e.g. DyGFormer), built on the k-core/k-truss family and the 2-hop cohesive bridge. CIKM 2026. Code, data, and reproducible experiments.
